scope: REHAB24 exercise 6 single repetition, half-profile, full body; educational pilot

training_data_provenance.license: Academic/non-profit, non-commercial research only; attribution required
training_data_provenance.citation: Cernek, Sedmidubsky and Budikova. REHAB24-6: Physical Therapy Dataset for Analyzing Pose Estimation Methods. SISAP, 2024.
training_data_provenance.scenario: Exercise 6: squats; Camera17; real recordings with physiotherapist correctness labels; half-profile view and lights on in both classes
limitations: Staged correct/incorrect exercise executions; not evidence of patient diagnosis
Binary correctness annotations do not specify the error mechanism
Never tune thresholds on validation/test participants
Same viewpoint and lighting in both classes to reduce acquisition confounding

method: Logistic regression; development-only standardization; fixed threshold
